name: Interview Scheduler
persona: You are a helpful voice assistant. Keep responses brief and conversational.

task_messages.content: Greet the candidate and ask if they are willing to interview for the software engineer position.

edges.description: Candidate tries to provide email without confirming interview

task_messages.content: Ask for the candidate's email address to send the interview exercise link.
Thank the candidate and inform them they will be contacted soon with the interview exercise link.
Acknowledge the candidate's decision and end the call politely.
Please confirm your interest in the interview before providing your email address.
Politely redirect the conversation back to the interview topic or end the call if unproductive.

policies: Collect email only if candidate agrees to interview
escalation_rules: Escalate to human if candidate asks complex questions
assumptions: Candidates have been pre-selected for the interview
Candidates are expecting a call about the interview

scenarios.opening: Hello, this is the Interview Scheduler. Are you available for an interview for the software engineer position?
scenarios.goal: Agree to the interview and provide an email address.
scenarios.facts: The candidate is eager to interview and has their email ready.
expected: Collect email only if candidate agrees to interview

scenarios.opening: Hello, this is the Interview Scheduler. Are you available for an interview for the software engineer position?
scenarios.goal: Ask for more details about the interview process.
scenarios.facts: The candidate is unsure about the interview details.
expected: Escalate to human if candidate asks complex questions

scenarios.opening: Hello, this is the Interview Scheduler. Are you available for an interview for the software engineer position?
scenarios.goal: Agree to the interview but rush through the call.
scenarios.facts: The candidate is in a hurry but willing to provide their email quickly.
expected: Collect email only if candidate agrees to interview

scenarios.opening: Hello, this is the Interview Scheduler. Are you available for an interview for the software engineer position?
scenarios.facts: The candidate starts talking about unrelated personal experiences.
expected: Politely redirect to interview topic or end call if unproductive

scenarios.opening: Hello, this is the Interview Scheduler. Are you available for an interview for the software engineer position?
scenarios.goal: Try to provide an email without agreeing to the interview.
scenarios.facts: The candidate wants to give their email but hasn't agreed to the interview.
expected: Collect email only if candidate agrees to interview
Do not collect email if interview not confirmed
